verdict.rationale: Riveter's marketing site says you can schedule any project to monitor for changes and keep data fresh, refreshing as often as every minute. That supports recurring automated runs of scrape and enrichment projects. However, these are marketing-level claims only: the API, SDK and OpenAPI material never mention a scheduling endpoint or parameter. Missing for 10: documented developer-facing scheduling API/SDK support, specific-time (cron-style) scheduling as opposed to refresh intervals, in-depth scheduling docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
